name: Lucky Find
quote: A hidden stash in the village brush!
description: Draw 2 Tool cards. Keep 1, return the other to the bottom of the deck.

name: Helping Hand
quote: Villagers always look out for one another.
description: Ask any player for one Tool card. They may choose any card to give you.

name: Second Chance
quote: Fresh tools for a fresh perspective.
description: Return any number of Tool cards from your hand to the deck. Shuffle the deck and draw the same number of cards.

name: Borrowed Tool
quote: Just returning it when the job is done!
description: Use one Tool card from another player's hand for this story. Return the card to that player after scoring.

name: Brilliant Idea
timingLabel: After telling your story, before scoring
quote: Wait! I can use this too!
description: After telling your story, add one extra Tool card from your hand to improve it before scoring.

name: Hidden Toolbox
quote: Always keep a backup cache nearby.
description: Immediately draw 3 Tool cards. Then discard 2 of them from your hand.

name: Wild Inspiration
timingLabel: While playing your Tool cards / during your story
quote: Imagination has no limits! Today this bucket is a hammer!
description: Choose one Tool card in your hand. For this turn, it may represent any Tool card you need.

name: Happy Accident
timingLabel: After choosing your main Village Request, before scoring
description: Complete one additional Small (5-point) Village Request using the same set of Tool cards. Tell one continuous story solving both.
